title: Ax-Prover: A Deep Reasoning Agentic Framework for Theorem Proving in Mathematics and Quantum Physics
abstract: arXiv:2510.12787v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present Ax-Prover, a multi-agent system for automated theorem proving in Lean that can solve problems across diverse scientific domains and operate either autonomously or collaboratively with human experts. To achieve this, Ax-Prover approaches scientific problem solving through formal proof generation, a process that demands both creative reasoning and strict syntactic rigor. Ax-Prover meets this challenge by equipping Large Language Models (LLMs), which provide knowledge and reasoning, with Lean tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which ensure formal correctness. To evaluate its performance as an autonomous prover, we benchmark our approach against frontier LLMs and specialized prover models on two public math benchmarks and on two Lean benchmarks we introduce in the fields of abstract algebra and quantum theory. On public datasets, Ax-Prover is competitive with state-of-the-art provers, while it largely outperforms them

translated_title: Ax-Prover：面向数学与量子物理定理证明的深度推理智能体框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Ax-Prover，这是一个用于Lean自动定理证明的多智能体系统，能够解决跨多个科学领域的问题，既可以自主运行，也可以与人类专家协作。为实现这一目标，Ax-Prover通过形式化证明生成来处理科学问题，这一过程既需要创造性推理，又需要严格的语法规范性。Ax-Prover通过模型上下文协议（MCP）为提供知识与推理能力的大语言模型（LLM）配备Lean工具来应对这一挑战，从而确保形式化正确性。为了评估其作为自主证明器的性能，我们在两个公开数学基准测试，以及我们新提出的两个Lean基准测试（分别涉及抽象代数和量子理论领域）上，将我们的方法与前沿大语言模型及专门的证明器模型进行了对比。在公开数据集上，Ax-Prover与最先进的证明器不相上下，同时它在（新引入的基准上）大幅超越这些方法。
tldr: Ax-Prover是一个将大语言模型的推理能力与通过MCP协议接入的Lean形式化工具相结合的多智能体定理证明框架，在公开数学基准上达到最先进水平，并在新提出的抽象代数与量子理论基准上大幅超越现有证明器。
en_tdlr: Ax-Prover is a multi-agent theorem-proving framework that equips LLMs with Lean tools via the Model Context Protocol, achieving state-of-the-art performance on public math benchmarks and largely outperforming existing provers on newly introduced abstract algebra and quantum theory benchmarks.
